judge: Two independent raters: (1) LLM judge, Claude Opus 4.8 (in-session, 2026-07-17); (2) one of the authors, labeling blind to the LLM's calls.
rater_agreement: 50/50 (both raters assigned the same label on every sampled event)
rubric: TRUE iff the marker verbalizes re-examination of prior reasoning: (a) doubting prior work, (b) announcing a re-check, (c) noticing an error/inconsistency, (d) revising the approach. FALSE: generic filler, confirmation/surprise without questioning, unrelated new thought.
borderline_note: Flagged by both raters as genuinely ambiguous under the rubric. Agreement does not make them unambiguous, so the flip bounds below are retained as the conservative interval.
